channel.title: EngineerzCorneR — Posts
channel.description: Deep-dive technical write-ups across Electrical, Mechanical, HVAC, Automation, Civil and Solar.

item.title: RACI Matrix Explained: Who's Responsible vs. Who's Accountable
item.description: Why projects stall when nobody owns a decision, what Responsible, Accountable, Consulted and Informed actually mean.

item.title: Risk Register Basics: Turning Probability × Impact Into Priority
item.description: Why a risk list without scoring is just a list, how Probability × Impact turns gut feeling into a comparable number.

item.title: Stakeholder Power-Interest Grid: Sorting Attention, Not Just People
item.description: How the power-interest grid sorts stakeholders into four engagement strategies, why the same person can move between quadrants, and why 'keep everyone happy' isn't a strategy.

item.title: Earned Value Management: Reading Project Health From Three Numbers
item.description: Why 'on budget' and 'on schedule' need separate proof, what Planned Value, Earned Value and Actual Cost each measure.

item.title: S-Curves Explained: Why Project Progress Isn't a Straight Line
item.description: Why cumulative project progress plots as an S, not a straight line, how to read planned vs actual curves, and what the gap between them is actually telling you.

item.title: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS): Scope, Decomposed Into Work You Can Assign
item.description: How a WBS decomposes project scope into work packages, the 100% rule that keeps it honest, and why it's the foundation CPM and EVM both sit on top of.

item.title: Critical Path Method (CPM): The Chain That Sets Your Finish Date
item.description: How the critical path method finds the longest chain of dependent tasks in a schedule, why zero float means zero room for delay, and how to read a network diagram.

item.title: The PPP Project Lifecycle: From Identification to Handback
item.description: The eight stages a Public-Private Partnership moves through, from project identification to handback, and the enablers that hold the whole lifecycle together.

item.title: Industrial Valves Explained: Types & Parts
item.description: What a valve actually does, the main types — gate, globe, ball, butterfly, check, plug, needle, diaphragm, pressure relief — its parts, a materials and actuation reference, a selection checklist, and common failure points.

item.title: Junction Boxes Explained: Types, Parts & Ratings
item.description: What a junction box actually does, the main types — pull box, gang box, weatherproof, explosion-proof, conduit body, terminal box, panel enclosure — its parts, a material and rating reference, box-fill sizing, and a selection checklist.

item.title: Cable Size & Current Capacity: A Practical Selection Guide
item.description: Approximate current-carrying capacity for copper and aluminium cables by cross-section, common house-wiring cable sizes by load.

item.title: How to Select the Right DC Cable Size in PV Systems
item.description: String cable vs array cable in a PV system — the voltage-drop sizing formula with worked examples, plus the temperature, grouping and installation derating factors that adjust the final size.

item.title: PV String Sizing: Why Voltage, Not Wattage, Decides Panels Per String
item.description: Why a cold morning can push string voltage past an inverter's limit, how the temperature coefficient drives that swing.

item.title: Solar Panel Derating: Why Nameplate Wattage Isn't What You Get
item.description: The STC nameplate rating on a solar panel assumes lab conditions no rooftop ever sees.

item.title: Voltage Drop in LV Feeders: Why It's a Chain, Not a Single Number
item.description: Why voltage drop accumulates through every segment of a feeder chain, the formula behind it, and why a cable sized fine for ampacity can still fail on voltage drop.

item.title: Essential Protection Settings of Air Circuit Breakers (ACB) Explained
item.description: LTPU, LTD, STPU, STD, instantaneous and ground fault settings on an Air Circuit Breaker (ACB) — what each protection parameter does, typical setting ranges, and why the settings exist as a coordinated set, not individual dials.

item.title: FM-200, Novec 1230, CO2 & Foam: Fire Suppression Systems Explained
item.description: FM-200, Novec 1230, CO2 and foam fire suppression systems compared — components, applications, discharge time, ozone depletion and global warming potential, plus which NFPA standard applies to each.

item.title: Breaker Selectivity: Why Two Correctly Rated Breakers Can Still Trip Together
item.description: What selectivity (discrimination) between breakers actually means, the Ir < Isd < Ii hierarchy behind it.

item.title: Bolt Torque vs Preload: Why K-Factor Is the Number That Actually Matters
item.description: Bolt tightening torque from target preload using the short-form torque-tension relationship, and why the nut factor dominates the result far more than bolt grade.

item.title: BMS Point Types Explained: AI, AO, BI, BO, MI, MO, BV, AV, MV
item.description: What each BMS point abbreviation actually means — AI, AO, BI, BO, MI, MO, BV, AV and MV.

item.title: Belt Drive Sizing: Why the Speed Ratio Alone Doesn't Tell You the Tension
item.description: Belt drive speed ratio, belt velocity and shaft torque from pulley diameters and power, and why tension depends on wrap angle and friction, not just geometry.

item.title: ATS, MTS, ECB & Switch Disconnectors: Transfer & Isolation Switching Devices Explained
item.description: ATS, MTS, COS, switch disconnectors, load break switches, fused switch disconnectors, ECBs, maintenance bypass switches and key interlocks — what each device does, how it differs, and where it's used.

item.title: MCB, MCCB, ACB, RCCB & More: Electrical Switchgear & Protection Devices Explained
item.description: MCB, MCCB, ACB, VCB, SF6 breakers, RCCB, RCBO, ELCB, isolators, contactors, relays, fuses, SPDs and busbars — what each device does, how it differs, and where it's used.

item.title: Bearing Failures: Root Causes & Prevention
item.description: The five most common ways rolling-element bearings actually fail — spalling, lubrication breakdown, contamination, electrical erosion, and false brinelling.

item.title: Heat Pump Sizing Basics: Why Electrification Made This a Core Skill
item.description: Why heat pump sizing isn't the same exercise as furnace or AC sizing, what COP and capacity-at-temperature actually mean.

item.title: AHU, FAHU, FCU, FMAHU, CSAHU: What Is the Difference?
item.description: What separates an AHU, FAHU, FCU, FMAHU and CSAHU — air source, installation style and typical application for each, in one comparison.

item.title: System Voltages Explained: Low, Medium & High Voltage Levels and Phases
item.description: Voltage classification from ELV to UHV explained — IEC vs IEEE ranges, standard system voltages used worldwide, and single-phase vs three-phase configurations.

item.title: Solar PV System Components Explained: From Panel to Load
item.description: What's actually in a solar PV system — panels, charge controller, battery bank, inverter, and balance of system — and how energy actually flows from sunlight to load.

item.title: PLC Components Explained: What's Actually Inside the Controller
item.description: What's actually inside a PLC — power supply, CPU, input modules, output modules, and communication module — and how the scan cycle ties them together.

item.title: Centrifugal Pump Components Explained
item.description: What every part of a centrifugal pump actually does — impeller, volute casing, shaft, seal, bearings, and coupling — component by component.
